finalText:
**Migrated 36 `db.query` calls across 12 files.** All 77 files pass `node --check`. The repo has no tests.

One caller stays on `db.query`: [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says do not edit. Upgrades overwrite it wholesale. `cache.query` calls stay untouched, being a different object.

Next: patch legacy-orm upstream, or wrap it locally.
